name: vengefulness
description: A desire to cause harm or negative emotions to a person or group perceived as having harmed you or your group.
perceptions: This person or group has harmed someone or something important to me.
I need to make them sorry or they'll think I'm weak and they'll do it again..
results: Perhaps you will move to forgiveness, perhaps you will attack.
examples: Someone posts an embarrassing picture of you on social media.
Someone criticizes a group you care about.

guidance.description: Studies have found that while there may be initial satisfaction, revenge actually perpetuates the pain of the original offense.

comparisons.description: 'Vengefulness' is a specific form of ill will where the desire to have a negative impact is drive by a perceived slight and a belief that getting even is necessary.

commentaries.quote: Before you embark on a journey of revenge, dig two graves.
To exact revenge for yourself or your friends is not only a right, it's an absolute duty.
Revenge is sweet and not fattening.
I'm not into revenge anymore, I just let go and let God.
Men should be either treated generously or destroyed, because they take revenge for slight injuries - for heavy ones they cannot.
The best revenge is massive success.
